body.text: Orbit Atlas is a remote mapping sprint. Participants must be at least 16 years old. Nonmembers must be at least 21 years old. Every participant younger than 18 must have guardian consent. Registration is accepted through 2034-09-07T16:00:00.000Z, including that exact instant, and is closed afterward. None of the fee categories waives any admission requirement. Eligible participants pay the first matching fee in this order: scholarship holders pay $0; members pay $14; students whose registration is submitted strictly before 2034-09-01T00:00:00.000Z pay $12; all other students pay $18; residents pay $19; everyone else pays $26. All amounts are USD. Categories may overlap, but fees never combine.
